performance.evidence: During this audit I fixed a BUG in the GPU benchmark: the timing loop did NOT call torch.mps.synchronize() before reading time.perf_counter(), so the reported '1.04ms inference latency' and '123K tok/s' measured CPU-dispatch time, not GPU execution. After adding per-iteration torch.mps.synchronize(), the honest numbers are inference median 2.20ms (end-to-end), 58K tok/s, batch=4 ~59K tok/s, batch=8 ~103K tok/s, sync overhead p50 0.27us. The 60KB current_allocated is the active-tensor allocator footprint, not the model size (model is ~5KB; 60KB includes intermediates).
open_issues: GPU numbers in THIRD_PASS_FINAL_REPORT.md (1.04ms / 123K / 212K) were CPU-dispatch only; the corrected end-to-end numbers are reported in this audit and stored in the re-run benchmark JSON.
